structure_plan.overview: Brick-built display statue of a white-robed minifigure holding a blue lightsaber; blocky proportions, ~8 studs wide x 6 studs deep x ~16 bricks tall. Colors: White robes, Yellow hair, LightBluishGray hilt, Blue blade, Black facial details.

subassemblies.name: Base + Feet
subassemblies.description: Low platform with two separated feet (standing pose) sized to support 8x6 footprint.

subassemblies.name: Left Leg
subassemblies.description: White 2-stud-wide leg column with slight knee/boot shaping via plates.

subassemblies.name: Right Leg
subassemblies.description: Matching white leg column, offset to create walking stance.

subassemblies.name: Torso + Belt
subassemblies.description: White torso block widening to ~6 studs; red belt stripe across front.

subassemblies.name: Left Arm (supporting)
subassemblies.description: White block arm angled inward using stepped plates; ends near saber grip.

subassemblies.name: Right Arm (gripping)
subassemblies.description: White block arm angled inward; positioned to align with saber hilt.

subassemblies.name: Head
subassemblies.description: White 4x4 head with simple black tile eyes/brow/mouth on front.

subassemblies.name: Hair
subassemblies.description: Yellow cap using slopes to form rounded hair silhouette.

subassemblies.name: Lightsaber
subassemblies.description: LightBluishGray hilt (2-stud thick) with Blue blade stacked upward.

step_outline.title: Base plate
step_outline.description: Build a rigid 8x6 base using overlapping 3024/3023/3022 plates (LightBluishGray or Black). Keep studs up.

step_outline.title: Feet layout
step_outline.description: Place two 4x3-ish white feet zones on the base: left foot slightly forward, right foot slightly back, leaving a 1-stud gap between feet.

step_outline.title: Build Left Leg
step_outline.description: Stack White bricks (3003/3004/3002) to form a 2x2-to-2x3 leg column above left foot; add a 3024/3023 plate layer mid-leg to suggest knee separation.

step_outline.title: Build Right Leg
step_outline.description: Mirror the left leg on the right foot; keep slight stance offset (one leg 1 plate higher at hip if needed using 3024 plates).

step_outline.title: Hips + robe hem
step_outline.description: Bridge legs with White plates (3024/3023) to create a 6-stud-wide hip deck; add a 1-plate-thick skirt/robe hem overhang by extending front plates 1 stud.

step_outline.title: Torso core
step_outline.description: Build up a White torso block to ~6 studs wide x 3 studs deep using 3004/3003/3002 bricks; keep a centered 2-stud-wide channel in front for arms/saber overlap.

step_outline.title: Belt stripe
step_outline.description: On the front of the torso, create a red belt band by placing a row of Red plates (3023/3024) across the front at mid-torso height.

step_outline.title: Left Arm subassembly
step_outline.description: Make a 2x2-ish White arm: stack 3004/3003 bricks and use a 1-plate step (3023/3024) to angle inward toward chest. Attach to left side of torso at shoulder height.

step_outline.title: Right Arm subassembly
step_outline.description: Build and attach a matching right arm, angled more inward so both hands area meets at center-front.

step_outline.title: Neck platform
step_outline.description: Add a White 4x4-ish plate platform on top of torso (use 3024/3023/3022) centered for head attachment.

step_outline.title: Head block
step_outline.description: Build a White 4x4 head to ~3 bricks tall. On the front, place Black tiles (3069b) for eyes/brow line and a smaller mouth line; optionally add 1x1 round tile (98138 Black) as nose/cheek mark.

step_outline.title: Hair cap
step_outline.description: Form yellow hair: top layer Yellow plates, then surround front/sides with Yellow slopes (3039/3040/3660/3665 as available) to create the swept hair silhouette.

step_outline.title: Lightsaber subassembly
step_outline.description: Hilt: stack LightBluishGray bricks/plates to a 2x2 x ~2-brick grip. Blade: stack Blue 1x2 bricks (3004/3003) upward to ~7–9 bricks tall; cap with a Blue or TransClear 1x1 round tile (98138).

step_outline.title: Pose + final mount
step_outline.description: Fix the lightsaber centered in front of torso by stud-connection to the arm tops/torso studs (use plates to lock). Adjust arms so they visually clasp the hilt; ensure blade rises beside head as in reference.

notes: Keep all geometry stud-aligned (no clips/bars available).
If hair slopes are insufficient, use stepped Yellow plates/tiles to suggest rounded hair.
If you prefer a lighter blade, replace Blue blade bricks with a Blue-to-TransClear tip using 98138 TransClear at the top.
Use tiles (3068b/3069b) on torso front to smooth robe look where desired, but keep enough exposed studs for saber anchoring.
